name: wallet-prototype
description: PERN + Solana Devnet custodial wallet prototype (development checkpoint)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @wallet/api" "npm run dev -w @wallet/web"
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate -w @wallet/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run db:seed -w @wallet/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @wallet/api && npm run build -w @wallet/web
